fields.description: If checked, apply late coming rules (Shift Management) — the legacy automatic point-deduction system. Otherwise, use standard attendance logic. NOTE: as of Aug 2026 policy, this is being superseded by the Short Leave Application system below; leave unchecked on new setups.
fields.label: Use Late Coming Rules (Legacy)

fields.description: Working days after the leave/request END date (holidays and weekly offs excluded). Employee can create backdated Leave or OD/WFH only until this many working days have passed after to_date. Does not apply to approval — HOD / Super HOD can approve anytime. HR can override. Default 3.
fields.label: Backdated Creation Window (Days)

fields.description: Working days (holidays and week offs excluded). Leave or OD/WFH of this many working days or more also needs Super HOD after HOD, including future and same-day requests. Below this value needs only HOD. Default 3.
fields.label: Super HOD After Working Days

fields.description: Maximum duration allowed for a single Personal Short Leave. Official Short Leave has no duration cap. Requests longer than this must be applied as Half Day / Full Day Leave instead. Approved Short Leave (Personal or Official) credits the actual late-in / early-out gap toward attendance working hours.
fields.label: Max Duration Per Short Leave (Hours)

fields.description: Maximum number of Personal Short Leaves an employee can apply for in a calendar month.
fields.label: Personal Short Leave — Monthly Cap

fields.description: Maximum number of Official Short Leaves per calendar month. Set to 0 for unlimited (current policy: unlimited).
fields.label: Official Short Leave — Monthly Cap (0 = Unlimited)

fields.description: Minimum hours worked on a Weekly Off or Holiday to count as a full day. Below this it counts as a half day. Used for PWO / PAW and HP / HP-A reporting and Compensatory Off. Default 6.
fields.label: Full Day Hours on Weekly Off / Holiday

fields.description: If enabled, employees earn Compensatory Off balance for qualifying attendance codes (e.g. working on Weekly Off or Holiday).
fields.label: Enable Comp Off Earning

fields.description: Automatically process and credit/reverse Comp Off when Attendance is submitted, updated, or cancelled.
fields.label: Auto Credit Comp Off on Attendance Submit/Update

fields.description: Leave Type credited when Comp Off is earned. Mandatory when Comp Off Earning is enabled.
fields.label: Comp Off Leave Type

fields.description: Mapping from Attendance Code to Comp Off days earned.
fields.label: Comp Off Rules
